title: Stellar Engines
description: Move a star. A Shkadov thruster is a vast curved mirror hung on one side of a star, held up by the star's own light, reflecting it back: the light pushes one way only, so the star drifts the other, with thrust F = fL/c. A Caplan thruster lifts matter from the star and fires it as a jet. Unlocks the Stellar Engine.

puzzle.goal: A mirror covering a fraction f of the sky round a star of luminosity L sends that light back. Write the net thrust F on the star, with c the speed of light.
puzzle.name: The Shkadov thrust
puzzle.ask: Find F in newtons for f = @{f}, L = @{L} W and c = @{c} m/s.
puzzle.method: Light carries momentum E/c. Unbalanced: the reflected fraction f pushes back on the star with f·L/c.
